parts: Take a one-dollar bill out of your wallet.
An eye floats above a pyramid.
People have said a secret brotherhood put it there.
The eye was not a Masonic invention: religious art used it for the Trinity.
The artist who proposed it for the seal, Du Simitière, was not a Mason.
Masonic handbooks show the eye as a standard symbol only in the seventeen nineties.
Among that first committee, only one is known to have been a Mason: Benjamin Franklin.
The idea that Masons created it is a myth.
